title: Low-rank approximation with the SVD
summary: Keep the k largest singular values to get the best rank-k approximation, measure the energy that you keep, and find the smallest rank for an energy target.

mutants.smallest_values: Keeps the singular values at the end of the list, which are the smallest, and not the largest.
mutants.energy_not_squared: Adds up the singular values and not their squares.
mutants.rank_off_by_one: Returns the index of the first value that reaches the target and not the index plus 1.
mutants.no_zero_guard: Divides by a total energy of zero for the zero matrix.
